Geometry confirmed: top-hat form (body ⌀40 × 8 + flange ⌀50 × 3.5), annular top recess ⌀47.5/⌀22 × 1.5 deep, through-hole ⌀16, two rim slots 5.6 × 2.8 through the flange at ±X. Re-submitting the matching script.

from build123d import *

# ---- dimensions read from the drawing ----
flange_od = 50.0     # mm  flange OD (front view ⌀50; right view R25 -> 2*25 = 50)
flange_t  = 3.5      # mm  flange thickness (from 1:1 front/right views)
body_od   = 40.0     # mm  body OD (from 1:1 front/right views)
body_h    = 8.0      # mm  body height (from 1:1 front/right views)
hole_d    = 16.0     # mm  through hole (front view ⌀16)
rec_od    = 47.5     # mm  top annular recess OD (top view 47.5)
rec_id    = 22.0     # mm  top annular recess ID (top view circle / ISO ring)
rec_depth = 1.5      # mm  recess depth (from 1:1 views)
slot_w    = 5.6      # mm  rim slot width, tangential (callout: 2 × 5.6 × 2.8 DEEP)
slot_deep = 2.8      # mm  rim slot radial depth (callout)

total_h = body_h + flange_t   # mm  overall height = 8 + 3.5 = 11.5

with BuildPart() as bp:
    # body (below) and flange (on top) — top-hat form, Z up
    Cylinder(radius=body_od / 2, height=body_h,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    with Locations((0, 0, body_h)):
        Cylinder(radius=flange_od / 2, height=flange_t,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # annular recess on the top face: cut outer disk, restore inner disk,
    # leaving a groove from rec_id to rec_od
    with Locations((0, 0, total_h - rec_depth)):
        Cylinder(radius=rec_od / 2, height=rec_depth,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
        Cylinder(radius=rec_id / 2, height=rec_depth,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                 mode=Mode.ADD)

    # through hole ⌀16 (cut after the recess restore so it stays open)
    Cylinder(radius=hole_d / 2, height=total_h,
             align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
             mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 2 rim slots at +X and -X: 5.6 tangential x 2.8 radial, through flange
    sx = flange_od / 2 - slot_deep / 2 + 0.5   # 0.5 mm overcut past the OD
    sz = body_h + (flange_t + 1.0) / 2         # spans full flange thickness
    for x in (sx, -sx):
        with Locations((x, 0, sz)):
            Box(slot_deep + 1.0, slot_w, flange_t + 1.0,
                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER),
                mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = bp.part
export_step(part, "output.step")
